title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Contract Provisions: Annuitization and Maturity
content:
The owner of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract may apply the contract value to an Ashgrove income annuity by signed election.

**Election.** Annuitization is processed only on an annuitization election signed by the owner and approved, as shown by the annuitization service request on the contract — except at the maturity date, where no election is needed.

**Surrender charge.** Annuitization from the tier's first charge-free annuitization contract year onward is free of surrender charge when the income option includes a life contingency or a period certain of at least the tier's shortest charge-free period certain. Otherwise the surrender charge under the full surrender provisions is deducted first.

**Minimum value.** The contract value applied must be at least the tier's smallest annuitizable contract value; a smaller value is paid in a lump sum.

**Maturity.** When the annuitant reaches the tier's maturity age, the contract is annuitized on a life with 10-year period certain basis unless the owner elects another option or a lump sum before that date.

**The income annuity.** It is issued to the same owner, with the same tax registration, on the annuitization date, with a purchase amount equal to the value applied.

## Decision table (hypothetical cases on a tier whose figures are contract year 2, a 5-year period certain and $5000)

| Contract year | Income option | Contract value | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | Life with 10-year period certain | $80000 | Annuitized free of surrender charge |
| 3 | 5-year period certain, no life contingency | $80000 | Free of surrender charge — period certain at least 5 years |
| 3 | 4-year period certain, no life contingency | $80000 | Surrender charge deducted first |
| 1 | Life only | $80000 | Surrender charge deducted first — before contract year 2 |
| 4 | Life only | $4000 | Paid in a lump sum — below $5000 |

**Basis question.** *What happens at the maturity age when the owner has made no election?* The contract is annuitized on a life with 10-year period certain basis.
